sentences.en: The king's eldest son is the heir to the throne.
sentences.zh: 国王的大儿子是王位的继承人。

sentences.en: His son-in-law will be the heir to the enormous fortune.
sentences.zh: 他的女婿将是那笔巨大财富的继承人。

sentences.en: It was an intricate scheme to defraud the rightful heirs.
sentences.zh: 这是一个精心策划的骗局，目的是欺骗真正的继承人。
